claims: Diego Garcia is a horseshoe-shaped coral atoll.
Diego Garcia is located in the central Indian Ocean.
Diego Garcia is about 7 degrees south of the equator.
Diego Garcia is the southernmost island of the Chagos Archipelago.
Diego Garcia acts as a joint U.K.-U.S. military base.
Diego Garcia is positioned about 1,000 miles south of India.
Diego Garcia is positioned about 2,100 miles east of Tanzania.
Diego Garcia is part of the British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).
Diego Garcia is situated at approximately 7°S latitude.
Diego Garcia is situated within the Chagos–Laccadive Ridge.
Diego Garcia has a deep natural harbor.
Diego Garcia has a long runway for heavy bombers.
Diego Garcia is a secure, restricted facility.
Diego Garcia is often referred to as "Footprint of Freedom".
Access to Diego Garcia is strictly controlled.
As of May 2025, a treaty was signed to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Archipelago from the UK to Mauritius.
The US/UK base is slated to remain under a long-term lease.
